reference_sql:
WITH daily AS (
  -- one row per day with webshop orders
  SELECT order_date, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  WHERE store_code = 'WEB-01'
    AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-06-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
  GROUP BY order_date
)
SELECT order_date, units,
  SUM(units) OVER (ORDER BY order_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_units
FROM daily
alternatives:
WITH daily AS (
  -- one row per day with webshop orders
  SELECT order_date, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  WHERE store_code = 'WEB-01'
    AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-06-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
  GROUP BY order_date
)
SELECT d.order_date, d.units,
  (SELECT SUM(d2.units) FROM daily d2 WHERE d2.order_date <= d.order_date) AS cumulative_units
FROM daily d

WITH daily AS (
  -- one row per day with webshop orders
  SELECT order_date, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  WHERE store_code = 'WEB-01'
    AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-06-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
  GROUP BY order_date
)
SELECT d.order_date, d.units, SUM(e.units) AS cumulative_units
FROM daily d
JOIN daily e ON e.order_date <= d.order_date
GROUP BY d.order_date, d.units
